description: Header file declaring functions related to sparse tensor multiplication in PyTorch's ATen library, specifically within the 'native' implementation for sparse tensors.

methods.name: mul_out_sparse_scalar
methods.description: Performs element-wise multiplication of sparse tensors with a scalar value, storing the result in the output tensor.

methods.name: mul_out_sparse_zerodim
methods.description: Performs element-wise multiplication of sparse tensor with a zero-dimensional tensor (scalar), storing the result in the output tensor.

methods.name: _mul_dense_sparse_out
methods.description: Computes the element-wise multiplication between a dense tensor and a sparse tensor, storing the result in the provided output tensor.

methods.name: _mul_sparse_sparse_zero_dim_out
methods.description: Handles multiplication between a zero-dimensional sparse tensor and another sparse tensor, storing the result.

methods.name: _mul_sparse_sparse_out
methods.description: Performs element-wise multiplication between two sparse tensors and stores the result.
